datasets.name: voids_by_employee
queryLines:
SELECT
  employee_id,
  location_id,
  location_name,
  location_status,
  items_voided AS `Items Voided`,
  valor_voided AS `Voided Value`,
  precio_prom_void AS `Avg Void Price`,
  checks_afectados AS `Checks Affected`,
  total_items_vendidos AS `Total Items Sold`,
  total_vendido AS `Total Sold`,
  pct_void_rate AS `Void Rate`
FROM
  fraud_voids_by_employee

datasets.name: risk_score
queryLines:
SELECT
  employee_id,
  location_id,
  pct_void_rate AS `Void Rate`,
  pct_free AS `Free Item Rate`,
  checks_con_espejo AS `Mirror Checks`,
  valor_voided AS `Voided Value`,
  night_voids AS `Night Voids`,
  flag_void_rate AS `Flag Void Rate`,
  flag_free_nc AS `Flag Free Items`,
  flag_espejo AS `Flag Mirror`,
  flag_monto AS `Flag Amount`,
  flag_night_voids AS `Flag Night Voids`,
  risk_score,
  CASE nivel_riesgo
    WHEN 'CRITICO' THEN 'CRITICAL'
    WHEN 'ALTO' THEN 'HIGH'
    WHEN 'MEDIO' THEN 'MEDIUM'
    WHEN 'BAJO' THEN 'LOW'
  END AS `Risk Level`
FROM
  fraud_risk_score
ORDER BY
  risk_score DESC

datasets.name: checks_most_voids
queryLines:
SELECT
  check_id,
  location_id,
  employee_id,
  items_voided AS `Items Voided`,
  valor_voided AS `Voided Value`,
  primera_orden AS `First Order`,
  ultima_orden AS `Last Order`
FROM
  fraud_checks_most_voids
ORDER BY
  items_voided DESC

datasets.name: weekly_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  semana_inicio AS `Week Start`,
  semana_fin AS `Week End`,
  total_items_voided AS `Items Voided`,
  total_checks_afectados AS `Checks Affected`,
  empleados_con_voids AS `Employees With Voids`,
  locaciones_con_voids AS `Locations With Voids`,
  valor_total_voided AS `Total Voided Value`,
  valor_prom_void AS `Avg Void Value`,
  valor_max_void AS `Max Void Value`,
  total_items_vendidos AS `Items Sold`,
  total_ventas AS `Total Sales`,
  total_checks_semana AS `Total Checks`,
  locaciones_activas AS `Active Locations`,
  pct_void_vs_ventas AS `Void Pct of Sales`,
  pct_void_rate AS `Void Rate`,
  top_empleado_voids AS `Top Employee Voids`,
  top_empleado_locacion AS `Top Employee Location`,
  top_empleado_valor AS `Top Employee Value`,
  top_locacion_voids AS `Top Location Voids`,
  top_locacion_valor AS `Top Location Value`
FROM
  fraud_weekly_summary

datasets.name: free_items_suspicious
queryLines:
SELECT
  check_id,
  location_name,
  location_status,
  total_items AS `Total Items`,
  free_items AS `Free Items`,
  pct_free_items AS `Free Items Pct`,
  q1_free AS `Q1 Free`,
  q3_free AS `Q3 Free`,
  iqr_free AS `IQR`,
  umbral_iqr AS `IQR Threshold`
FROM
  fraud_free_items_suspicious
ORDER BY
  pct_free_items DESC

datasets.name: voids_vs_sold
queryLines:
SELECT
  check_id,
  location_id,
  employee_id,
  items_voided AS `Items Voided`,
  items_vendidos AS `Items Sold`,
  valor_voided AS `Voided Value`,
  valor_vendido AS `Sold Value`,
  pct_void_rate AS `Void Rate`,
  items_espejo AS `Mirror Items`,
  flag_patron_espejo AS `Mirror Pattern`
FROM
  fraud_voids_vs_sold
ORDER BY
  items_espejo DESC

datasets.name: voids_by_hour

datasets.name: top_voided_items
queryLines:

datasets.name: pipeline_log
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  run_timestamp,
  status,
  queries_executed
FROM
  fraud_pipeline_run_log
ORDER BY
  run_id DESC
